subject: Life Skills
title: The Role of Perception
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Role of Perception.

hook.text: Two people witness the same car accident and give completely contradictory statements to police.

buildup.text: Perception is shaped by experience, culture, mood, and attention. No two people see events identically.

discovery.text: In conflict, each side believes their version is the truth. Both can be right about different parts.

twist.text: Insisting on one truth escalates conflict. Acknowledging multiple truths opens the door to resolution.

climax.text: Say 'I see it differently' instead of 'you're wrong.' This validates their view without surrendering yours.

punchline.text: Two truths can coexist. Start there.

quiz.question: Why do people often disagree about the same event?
options: Perception is shaped by personal experience and attention
